title: Normalized etale and ringed derived comparison data
statement: For the literal scalar functors of [def-pur-etale-ringed-projection-presentation], define NativeIdentification as the existing NormalizedComparison [def-sfb-derived-projection-comparison-squares] between the canonical ringed K-injective derived adjunction and the published etale derived inverse/direct-image adjunction. Its left and right normalizations are [def-pur-etale-ringed-derived-normalization]; its ringed monoidal tensorator has the specified ordinary pure-tensor and K-flat total normalization, and its native monoidal tensorator is the canonical etale one [lem-kun-inverse-image-monoidal]. It retains the full Hom-bijection, unit and counit equations and the tensor and counit-transpose projection squares. Define PublishedProjectionSquare by replacing the abstract projection maps in that square with the recorded ringed edge projection and the published etale projection map [def-kun-projection-formula-map], on every pair of unbounded derived inputs.
